» About WLC
Where women lead with clarity, courage & community.
Women Leadership Circle is a growing circle of ambitious women building momentum together — an ecosystem of peer circles, mentorship, and access to opportunity. Founded in Mumbai, WLC has now extended to Delhi NCR.
» Our events
WLC’s ecosystem brings members together through Learning — masterclasses, mindset circles, and leadership dialogues — and Events like Connect gatherings, panels, and collaborative experiences. Members-only Circles, Book Club, Tribe, and Ignite sessions round out a calendar built for connection, growth, and access to the country’s most influential women leaders.
A season of WLC in Mumbai.
